title: Maratón de Buenos Aires 2026: cortes de calle, corrales y logística — Infobae
claims: The 2026 Buenos Aires Marathon was scheduled for Sunday 20 September, with the main start at 07:00 at Figueroa Alcorta and Dorrego, awards around 10:00 and the official close at 13:00.
The field was 16,384 runners from 64 countries, including 10,615 Argentines, 5,769 foreigners, 5,246 women, and representatives of all 24 Argentine jurisdictions.
The start was staggered by declared time: corral P for athletes with disabilities at 06:57, followed by two elite groups at 07:00 and 07:01.
Aid stations ran every 2.5 km from km 5, with water and isotonic drink; banana was offered at km 20 and km 30.
The elite men all had personal bests under 2:09, with Bethwel Kibet's 2:04:37 from Amsterdam 2023 the fastest listed; the elite women were under 2:27.
Brazil supplied 2,769 of the 5,769 foreign runners; Chile 499, Colombia 468, Uruguay 455, Peru 378 and Mexico 190.
